title: Copper Lighthouse — keeper's page
text: At midnight on Night Three, the north lantern stayed dark. A keeper recorded that no beam crossed the harbor. The generator cabinet was sealed with red wax.

title: The marigold greenhouse
text: The greenhouse clock struck thirteen while the marigolds slept beneath a frost of silver dust. An apprentice left paper butterflies on the empty bench. The glass roof reflected a sky without stars.

title: The attic wardrobe
text: A wooden wardrobe in the attic hummed whenever rain touched its copper hinges. Inside were a velvet cloak, three broken combs and a jar of dried lavender. Nobody opened its smallest drawer.
